# EEG NLL tables with GP baselines (generated by debug/eeg_nll_tables.py)

GP fits that blow up dominate some GP means: Bruinsma Rec has 1/316 tasks at NLL 2638 (GP total median 1.44, mean without it 1.51); Hassan Int has 5/564 (M=16) and 8/564 (M=64) tasks above 5 (GP total medians 0.056 and -0.148). Marginal NLLs of the TFM rows come from the main run; the GP run's recomputed marginals agree to mean |diff| <= 1.5e-3 (max 0.07, Kumo).

NLL per target value (lower is better), mean ± 1.96 SE, on each unit's GP subset (Hassan pooled over N).
